article_title: IAsyncActionFilter：把异步检查留在管道里
core_theme: 用 IAsyncActionFilter 把需要等待数据库或服务的检查放在操作方法前后：单方法 OnActionExecutionAsync 包裹 next() 委托，可短路请求；纯策略检查改用授权过滤器
reader_takeaway: 能照着示例做出邮箱验证过滤器：注册 DI、ServiceFilter 应用、验证 403 短路
summary_angle: 一个「等待式检查」从二十个控制器里抽出来，变成管道里一道带闸门的关卡：通过则放行（next 继续），不通过则整体短路

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文开篇：同样的检查逻辑被复制进多个控制器，且检查本身需要 await（数据库/服务调用）
information_blocks.visual_idea: 左侧：一排堆叠的控制器卡片，每张都贴着同一条检查条

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 OnActionExecutionAsync 单方法包裹 next() 委托段：调用 next() 继续管道，跳过并设置 context.Result 完全短路
information_blocks.visual_idea: 中间：一条管道上的闸门（verify 关卡），通过的箭头继续向后，被拒的箭头折返

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Good fits 与 ⚠️ 边界：邮箱/订阅验证、业务规则、条件阻塞；纯角色或策略检查改用 IAsyncAuthorizationFilter
information_blocks.visual_idea: 右侧：过滤后的控制器整齐一排，只有放行的请求进入，附授权过滤器小徽章

main_metaphor: 把重复的等待式检查收敛成管道中的一道闸门
primary_subject: 一条请求管道上的闸门关卡（插画式阀门 / 检查口）
subject_action: 闸门开启放行通过检查的请求，未通过的请求被挡回并短路

final_prompt: Use the current cover direction as the base. Keep the strongest part of the composition and preserve the summary angle: stacked controller cards each carrying the same check tag on the left converge into one illustrated gate on the pipeline in the middle; passed requests flow through with a green light, rejected requests bounce back; on the right controllers stand in a tidy row with only cleared requests entering. Preserve the core metaphor: gather repeated waiting checks into one gate on the pipeline. Keep these narrative beats readable and source-grounded: (1) stacked controller cards with check tags, visible label 重复检查; (2) the gate with green pass and rejected arrows, visible label 一道闸门; (3) tidy controllers with cleared requests and a small authorization badge, visible label 检查一次. Change only these points: sharpen the three Chinese chip labels so they are crisp and legible; refine the gate metal and lighting so details stay clean; keep the composition and palette identical. Make the image feel more like editorial technical illustration combined with this selected visual style descriptor: game concept art illustration, clear hero object, readable environment storytelling, polished lighting, production-art detail. Preserve one clear focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats in a wide 2.35:1 frame. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Primary subject should remain: the illustrated check-point gate on the pipeline. Simplify the background so that only the canyon-like environment remains as supporting context. Color palette: deep blue-grey, warm gold highlights, teal green pass color, warning orange. Visible text policy: keep only the approved short Chinese labels 重复检查 / 一道闸门 / 检查一次; no poster title, no long sentence captions, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, and no fake architecture node names.
